verdict.rationale: The only first-party SDK evidence is the onramp's "Embedded components onramp (mobile SDK)" and a passing llms.txt instruction about installing Stripe npm packages. That confirms official SDKs exist for at least part of the crypto surface, but there is no documentation of server-side SDK coverage for stablecoin payments, payouts or financial accounts. The MCP server and CLI are adjacent tools and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented official server-side SDKs (languages, coverage of stablecoin/crypto APIs), SDK reference docs or examples for crypto endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
